items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:50:1
items.html: And the Patach indicates Hochma, and they are the Nekudot: That is, the Nekudot, meaning the seven lower Sefirot, emerged from this coupling of Kamatz and Patach, which are Keter and Hochma, as above. And then the Nekudot of SAG come out and are revealed, as is written further on.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:50:2
items.html:
The Taamim of SAG, which are the discernment of the lights of AHP etc., and when the discernment of the Nekudot came etc., they were opened in the opening of the eyes: And here you must understand the inversion that came about through the ascent of the bottom Hey to the Einayim, whereby the Nekudot preceded the Taamim. For the essential discernment between Taamim and Nekudot is that the Taamim of SAG, which are as far as the Tabur, did not join with the bottom Hey, that is, with the inner ZON of AK; whereas the Nekudot of SAG, which are the nine lower ones from Hochma downward, joined with the bottom Hey and rose as MAN to the Einayim, as above in the words of the ARI (page 396, item 6, and in the Inner Light there). Now here, in the Partzuf that emerged from this coupling in the Nikvey Einayim, the opposite came about. For the Nekudot, that is, the joining of the first Hey with the bottom Hey, came about in the Nikvey Einayim, while the Taamim, that is, the first Hey that did not join at all with the bottom Hey, emerged in AHP, as above (in the Inner Light, page 436, the passage beginning “However”). Thus the Nekudot are above, in the Nikvey Einayim, and the Taamim below, in AHP, which is the opposite of the way they stand in SAG, where the Taamim are above the Tabur and the Nekudot were below the Tabur. In truth, however, this is still not called an emergence of the Nekudot, for as long as the Nekudot are in the Nikvey Einayim they are not revealed outward, since they are there in the secret of the Kamatz, as above (page 435, the passage beginning “The seven”). Rather, afterwards, by means of the coupling of AB SAG, the Nekudot come out from the Einayim to the Peh, beneath the Taamim; it is discerned that the dot that clung to the Patach withdrew and separated from there, and the Einayim remained in the secret of a Patach alone, without a dot, and then the Einayim were opened, and AHP returns to the Rosh, and the ZAT come to their place.
And this is what he says, “as long as only the Taamim of SAG had come out, the lights were sealed” — that is, as long as the bottom Hey was in the Einayim, so that the Nekudot could not come out and only the Taamim alone could, in the secret of YHV that are clean of the bottom Hey, the lights were then sealed and closed. “And when the discernment of the Nekudot came, which are Hochma, which is Patach, they were opened in the opening of the eyes” — as above, for then the dot that clung to the Patach in the Einayim descended, and the light of the Nekudot of SAG, which are Hochma, is revealed outward, as above (page 435, the passage beginning “Hochma”).
